where: #r07 table.bench "İncelenen uygulamalar (26)", for example the ChatGPT row: "Açılan kaynaklarda tasarım bilgisi yok."
problem: The owner asked "çok satan modern uygulama ui larını da incelemeni" and rubric R1 requires best-selling app UIs. In this table 102 of 130 design cells (Renk, Köşe, Yazı, Hareket, Gezinme) are placeholders. Eleven rows contain no UI observation at all: ChatGPT (the world's most downloaded app), e-Devlet (the only Turkish top-10 app listed), Deprem Ağı, Strava, Taobao, iA Writer, Mela, Opal, Goodnotes, Feather and Speechify. R07-F01 to F07 are download and award lists, not UI analysis, and the open questions admit that Getir, Papara, Enpara, Trendyol and Revolut were not examined. Calling these 26 rows "inceleme" in #one-cikanlar overstates the work.
fix: Study the actual screens. Pull screenshotUrls from the iTunes lookup API and the Play listing screenshots for the apps Turkish students use (ChatGPT, Instagram, WhatsApp, e-Devlet, Trendyol, Getir, Spotify, Google Classroom) and for the 2025 and 2026 ADA winners. Measure background, accent and text colors with color.js and note radius, tab bar and navigation per app. Fold any row that stays empty into a single sentence, and rename the heading to match what was actually done.
